periods.time: Selection battle against Toka and final-day crisis
periods.label: 深海魔女的败北与声援
titles: 破军学园一年级B级伐刀者

status.current: eliminated from Seven Stars selection but becomes one of Ikki's strongest supporters

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother and ideal; her desire to stand beside him motivates her training and later her support.
relationships.toka-todo: Opponent who defeats her in a B-rank duel; later asks her to consider stopping Ikki from fighting.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Love rival turned ally; Shizuku attacks Stella when she says she may break up with Ikki, then helps support Ikki.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Closest confidant; he holds her while she cries after losing.

periods.summary: The prologue reveals Shizuku's childhood disdain for hypocritical adults and her decisive attachment to Ikki, the only person who corrected her. Her match against Toka tests whether she can stand beside Ikki at the Seven Stars Festival. She uses refined water control, Frozen Plains, White Night Barrier and Scarlet Water Blade, but Toka's martial skill, Reverse Sight and Raikiri overwhelm her; she loses while still clutching Toka's foot, proving she fought to the end. Afterward she breaks down only in Alice's arms. During the scandal she refuses to let Stella call the relationship a mistake, later chooses not to stop Ikki despite Toka's request, and gathers students to cheer him at the gate.

key_events.summary: Recalls why she loves and follows Ikki before facing Toka.
Fights Toka with all her water techniques but loses to Raikiri.
Fires an ice spear at Stella after Stella suggests breaking up with Ikki.
Hears Toka's warning and chooses to bet on Ikki's will.
Catches Ikki at the gate and tells him he is not alone.
